# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (Mar 26, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw updates to Sepolia tasks and significant progress in closing several long-standing issues related to L2CM upgrades and flaky tests. Discussions on active issues focused on debugging test flakiness, interop transaction pool behavior, and future upgrade considerations.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Sepolia Task Status Updates
The status of Arena-Z Sepolia tasks for proposer rotation and fee vault updates were marked as executed, indicating progress in network operations. ([#1390](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1390))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### L2CM Upgrade System Enhancements
Several issues related to the L2 Contract Manager (L2CM) upgrade system were closed, including the creation of a Solidity script for deterministic JSON NUT bundles ([#18834](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18834), [#18840](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18840)), and the implementation of dev feature flag support ([#18838](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18838)). Additionally, a `just` command for running L2 upgrade fork tests was added ([#18841](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18841)).

### Flaky Test Resolution
A flaky test related to `TestCLELDivergence` was closed after mitigation efforts were implemented, with a discussion on whether to keep such issues open until flakiness completely disappears. ([#19681](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19681)) Another flaky test concerning `TestPreinteropFaultProofs_TraceExtensionActivation` was also closed, with a potential fix identified in a related pull request. ([#19760](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19760))

## NEW ISSUES

### Breaking Change in `StorageKeys` Value
A new issue was opened regarding a breaking change in the `StorageKeys` value in `op-geth` v1.101701.0, where `null` is returned instead of `[]`. This is attributed to the `SortedFunc` in Go's `slices` package returning `nil` for empty arrays. ([#780](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/780))

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Flaky Test: `TestCLELDivergence` ([#19681](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19681))
Discussions revolved around the nature of a test flake. Initially, it was suggested that a fix in PR #19733 might resolve the issue. Further investigation revealed that the test's expectation of CL-EL divergence persistence might be incorrect, as the derivation pipeline resetting the unsafe head could be expected behavior. The issue was ultimately closed, with a suggestion to reopen if the flake reappears, to avoid accumulating stale issues.

### Flaky Test: `TestPreinteropFaultProofs_TraceExtensionActivation` ([#19760](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19760))
The discussion centered on whether PR #19745 would fix this flaky test. It was confirmed that the PR, which replaces a multi-transaction ownership transfer pattern with EIP-7702 SetCode transactions, would eliminate the nonce race condition causing the flake. The issue was subsequently closed.

### Contracts: Prove withdrawals using chain-specific root claim ([#18517](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18517))
There was a query about closing this issue, as the approach might have changed to use `rootClaimByChainId` based on the game type. Previously, the issue was moved to the backlog, awaiting the execution of U19 and the support of `rootClaimByChainId` by FaultDisputeGames.

### [L2CM] Investigate adding an array of predeploys to increase upgrade safety ([#19260](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19260))
A detailed analysis highlighted a structural gap in the upgrade pipeline where there's no centralized source of truth for which implementations need to be deployed, leading to potential silent failures. While an immediate bug (missing `L2DevFeatureFlags` deployment) was fixed by PR #19464, the underlying architectural issue remains. The discussion also pointed out a latent `ConditionalDeployer` issue that could lead to a worse failure mode in future upgrades if not addressed.

### Document interop tx pool eviction behavior on reorg ([#19351](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19351))
A question was raised regarding the behavior of interop transactions in the mempool during a reorg. Specifically, it was asked whether the mempool explicitly iterates and drops interop transactions or if periodic re-evaluation handles this, following a change in `op-geth` that drops all interop executing messages on any reorg.

### Remove Karst-specific upgrade transactions from GenerateNUTBundle ([#19369](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/19369))
A comment outlined the necessary updates to `UpgradeUtils.getTransactionCount()` and the `GasLimits` struct when removing the Karst-specific transactions from `GenerateNUTBundle.s.sol`. This ensures consistency and accuracy after the Karst upgrade is deployed to all networks.
